ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won"), ISCHANGED(StageName), OR( Account.RecordType.DeveloperName = "Prospect_Group", Account.RecordType.DeveloperName = "Prospect_Subsidiary" ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: "You cannot close an Opportunity if the associated client is a 'Prospect'. Closing an Opportunity implies that the contract is signed and the client must be 'Onboarded' (or 'Active')."
